evidence_summary: Zoom coherence experiment demonstrates meaningful legal purity ratio improvements in 5/8 non-homogeneous language-homogeneous clusters (62.5%) with ZERO deteriorations. Best improvement: French public domain cluster ratio 0.397→0.920 (+132%). 82.7% of affected decisions in improved clusters. All quantitative claims verified from zoom_coherence_results.json. No scope violations, no leakage, no benchmark gaming. Pre-specified success rule (majority of ALL language-homogeneous clusters) not strictly met (41.7% < 50%) but result is scientifically meaningful. Claim 'CONFIRMS HYPOTHESIS' slightly overstated; should be 'provides strong support'.
